d:
Lime's new Halibel doujin. Working on a proper EN translation, but let me know if you want the "official" less accurate translation to hold you over in the meantime, and I'll upload that. Also, @burstdragon323, you asked something on the last gallery, I sent you a message on the forums.

Anyways, here's Lime's Note:

I drew Tier Harribel from BLEACH.

The "Marrying a Beautiful Princess" series is now on its fifth installment; time really flies.

The idea for this project simply stemmed from a desire to draw something flexible. The combination of the warrior Harribel and yoga seemed interesting for some reason.

I hadn't given it much thought regarding the costume, but a regular yoga costume wouldn't be interesting, so I went with a look that shows off my lower bust, imagining herself before Resurrección.
n: [Doujinshi] [PURPLE HAZE (Lime)] Marrying a Beautiful Princess: Flexible Conception Focused Sex  (Bleach)
